note: Media Entity Generic ships exactly one core-Media source plugin: Drupal\media_entity_generic\Plugin\media\Source\Generic, @MediaSource(id = 'generic', allowed_field_types = {'string'}, default_thumbnail_filename = 'generic.png'), extends MediaSourceBase, getMetadataAttributes() returns [], createSourceFieldStorage() sets custom_storage=TRUE. No settings form, no configure route, no permissions, no Drush, no services. A media type using it is a media.type.<id> config entity with source: generic and source_configuration.source_field: <string field>. Historically an upgrade bridge from contrib Media Entity 1.x's 'Generic' provider to Media in core; hook_requirements blocks install while media_entity < 8.x-2 is enabled. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real media_type config, verified against live media types (prefixed meg_) and their string source fields (field_meg_*).

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal media_entity_generic module provide, and what is the machine id of the media source plugin it adds?
evals.expected_output: It provides a single core-Media source plugin with id 'generic' ('Generic media'), a MediaSourceBase subclass that stores an arbitrary string value as the media's source field and uses a generic placeholder thumbnail.

evals.prompt: If I create a Drupal media type using the 'Generic' media source from media_entity_generic, what field type is its source field, and does the source expose any metadata attributes?
evals.expected_output: The Generic source allows only the 'string' field type (allowed_field_types = {"string"}), so its source field is a plain text string. It exposes no metadata attributes (getMetadataAttributes() returns an empty array).

evals.prompt: Why does the Drupal media_entity_generic module exist and when would it be enabled automatically?
evals.expected_output: It is a bridge that lets sites using the contributed Media Entity 1.x 'Generic' provider upgrade to Media in core (Drupal 8.4+); during that upgrade the module is enabled automatically. hook_requirements() blocks installation while contrib media_entity 1.x is still enabled.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a media type with machine name 'meg_known'. Inspect the live configuration and state which media source plugin it uses.
evals.expected_output: The media type meg_known uses the 'generic' media source (media.type.meg_known -> source: generic).

evals.prompt: The media type 'meg_field' on this site uses the Generic media source. Inspect the live configuration and give the machine name of its source field.
evals.expected_output: Its source field is field_meg_code: media.type.meg_field -> source_configuration.source_field = field_meg_code.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a new media type with machine name 'meg_task' that uses the 'Generic' media source provided by media_entity_generic. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create media.type.meg_task with source: generic (MediaType::create(['id'=>'meg_task','label'=>...,'source'=>'generic'])->save()), typically also creating and wiring a string source field via the source's createSourceField().

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a media type 'meg_task2' that uses the Generic media source (media_entity_generic) and whose source field is a string field with machine name 'field_meg_ref'. Wire the source field up and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create media.type.meg_task2 with source: generic, create a 'string' FieldStorageConfig/FieldConfig named field_meg_ref on the media entity/meg_task2 bundle, and set source_configuration.source_field = field_meg_ref.
